comparison.objective: Order three similar cans by height on marked shelf locations; candidate finishes four HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual size comparison and upright pick-and-place versus small recessed alignment, impact-force regulation, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: All three cans upright on the correct marks in 6/9/12 cm order versus four safe tang fractures and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Perceptual sorting and shelf placement do not test bimanual impact, fracture verification, or retained-coil protection.
